meta.title: A buyer cannot download a stage's bid history
gaps: act 1: cannot be executed — the buyer's web-console session may not call GET /v1/trade/:id/trade_history (trade#trade_history is not on that app's list in config/app_auth_config.yml); such a call is answered 401 and signs the session out
The buyer cannot execute GET /v1/trade/{{tradeId}}/trade_history from the web-console session, and no available operation or library case covers stage bid history download.
